content: GIMP Curves docs (docs.gimp.org 2.10): curve maps input tone (x, 0..255) to output tone (y, 0..255) on a grid; default straight diagonal; fixed endpoints at (0,0)/(255,255) that cannot be deleted; click to create a point, drag to move; Input/Output spin buttons set the selected point numerically; arrow keys move the active point (Left/Right switch point activation); histogram rendered gray in the chart as reference only; channel selector (Value + R/G/B channels); segment = tonal range between two points; delete a point by moving it past its neighbor (GIMP) — Photoshop uses select+Delete or drag-off; S-curve = steeper midtones = contrast increase; invert = endpoints swapped. GIMP is a Photoshop-convention-family editor.
